slides.headline: Sonic Pico Park Is Out: 8-Player Co-Op for ₹649

slides.stat_label: Out Now on PC, PS5, Xbox and Switch
bullets: Online cross-play, so mixed-console friend groups can team up
One PC can bring up to 7 players online
All stages are playable whether you are 2 or 8

slides.stat_label: Can Play Remotely on One Steam Copy
bullets: Remote Play Together: only the host buys the game
Friends join from a PC, phone or tablet
Steam only; over 4 players needs fast internet
slides.credit_line: Sources: Valve, Video Games Chronicle, Wccftech, Steam
